props.heading: First, the part that's already true: anyone with Claude or any other CLI can gen
props.body: The capability exists. The question is what the starting material is — and right now, for most users, the starting material is the general training distribution of a large language model.

props.heading: Garbage in, garbage out cuts both ways.
props.body: A blank prompt inherits whatever patterns dominated the training data for that subject — which may or may not reflect current research, may or may not be structured for learning, and almost certainly isn't fact-checked to the level of professional course material.

props.heading: Medhavy is a connector, not another app — like Higgsfield for cinematic video.
props.body: You keep your Claude subscription. You add the MCP connector in settings. Now your Claude has access to the Humanitarians AI corpus: fact-checked claims, authored textbooks, tested exercises, produced videos.

props.heading: And the design decisions — accessibility compliance, pedagogical sequencing, fac
props.body: The creator gets good defaults and full override on any choice.
